text:
Lena: putting a proposal on the table: a webinar framed as "Inference playbooks for product teams" + a separate follow-up lab for engineers. want to test messaging that starts at product impact rather than infra.

Omar: I like the funnel idea. messaging test: 3 variants for the landing copy - "Cost-first", "Latency-first", "Reliability-first". run small A/B on initial signup headline.

Ravi: suggest we also test CTAs: "See benchmarks" vs "See demo". measure which yields higher trial requests.

Lena: speakers: plotting to have Priya speak on benchmarks, Chris on routing + reliability, and a customer (Acme) for a short case. need to confirm customer availability.

Omar: rehearsal plan: one full dress, and 2 quick tech checks (48h and 2h out). fallback pre-record for case study.

Ravi: instrumentation: UTM per headline + CTA; capture "primary problem" in signup. post-event, send segmented follow-ups: benchmarks -> invites to deep dive, demo -> lab RSVP.

Support-bot: Reminder: ensure no real customer logs in demo videos. Redact or use mock data.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Inference playbooks webinar" on 2025-09-09 15:00 UTC. Rehearsal: 2025-09-07 15:00 UTC.

Lena: timeline: draft A/B headlines by Fri, confirm customer by Mon, create fallback vids by Sep 1. volunteers for post-event follow-ups?

Omar: i'll take the A/B setup and initial analysis automation.

Ravi: i'll own CTA variants + post-event sequence.

Lena: cool. keep this thread for headline variants only after today. thanks!
